predictions: Ok, we're still plodding along here early on, hitting about 2/3 of the picks. 15-8 last week takes us to 29-15 so far, for a correct pick rate of 65.9%. And this season has started pretty much like any other, as 5 of the 8 that I got wrong last week would have flipped or been tied with a single dart. I guess we just have a pretty competitively balanced series of divisions here in RDL-land. I'm still willing to fire off guesses though, so here we go with another set of random offerings.

Match of the week: (E Div.) Hump Day! @ Irish Ton. Kind of amazing, but this is the only match this week (and it's only week 3!) that has two undefeated teams. And one of these two has only played one time so far. As I wrote in the preseason issue, I think the Duckas are the team to beat here in E, but it's the winner of this match that gets first chance at being the Duckas top competitor. I'll stick with Hump Day here, 15-9.

Match #2: (D Div.) Cheap Shots @ Off Constantly-Reboot. Constantly got a clutch win without a couple of their top throwers. And if they're going to get those kind of wins, that bodes pretty well for a full-on season-long run. If that's the plan, they'll certainly have to win matches like this one. I think OC's future is bright, and they win this one, 14-10.

Match #3: (F Div.) Village Idiots @ Ton 80 Proof. After getting kinda thumped by a team up from G in week 1, Ton 80 basically rolled right over one of the better teams left from F in week 2. Which mostly means that… I have no idea about those guys at all. I wasn't quite ready to jump in with the Idiots in F yet, but I guess it's time. Idiots, 13-11.

Match #4: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ Double In, Uber Out. After two weeks, nobody in B is averaging more than 14 points, and only one team was able to reach 2-0. Even the only 0-2 team is averaging 11.5 per week, so B is still as wide open as I predicted (feared?). Not even sure what I should base picks on here. I guess I'll take Serious again, 14-10.

Match #5: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Dart Side of the Moon. The Sharks hit the win column last week, while Dart Side was busy reeling in a second straight. And somehow, Dart Side has done that despite averaging below 12 per week so far. Despite that low point total, I'm still thinking Dart Side is on the right path, and I'll stick with them, 13-11.

Match #6: (D Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ BullsHit. These two are in the D bottom trio, sitting a combined 0-3 so far. Together, they've already lost three pretty close ones, so somebody is going to be pretty happy to get over the hump here. Let's take BullsHit, 13-11.

Match #7: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Sharky's Machine. Oh boy, a rough start happening here. Death Throw has already dropped two straight, and the Machine got nipped pretty good by the Ducks. Maybe Death Throw remembers how to win a doubles game? 13-11.

Match #8: (C Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Shooter McGavin. Show Me got a critical win last week to remain unblemished, while McGavin came within a dart of joining them. Maybe this pairing is going to be quite a critical one in the C race. I'll take Show Me, 14-10.

Match #9: (B Div.) Blindsided @ Iceman's Ear Defenders. These B teams are separated by 9 points (which is the largest spread between any two B teams), but they are a long way from being "far apart." This division NEEDS to have no undefeated teams, so… IED, 13-11.
Match #10: (G Div.) Ones Are Closed @ The Rock Bottoms. Early version of the fight to avoid the RDL ultimate cellar. While I think the Rock Bottoms will soon be Rock Climbers, it's the Ones, 15-9.

Match #11: (F Div.) Neighborhood Dart Knights @ Shoot-Da-Bull. Eek, only one F team will start out bagel-and-three, and that team is the loser of this battle. The Dart Knights take this close one, 14-10.
Match #12: (B Div.) Boom Baby @ Dart Attack. Boom has a habit of letting me down when I pick them. Dart Attacks makes a habit of upsetting my picks when I pick against them. Oh no… Boom, 13-11.
